title.zh: IndexTTS-2.5 官方语音合成演示

compare.runtime: 官方托管 Gradio Space（hf.space 直连），浏览器即用，无需本地部署；config 显示 auth_required: false

compare.commercial: 未确认（Space 卡片标 license: other，自定义许可，非 OSI）

notes.zh: IndexTeam 官方 Space，演示 IndexTTS-2.5 零样本语音合成。发布日取官方 GitHub release v2.5.0 的 published 日期（2026-08-13，GitHub API 原文）。核验方式：huggingface.co 主站在本地网络不可达，demo 经官方 hf.space 直连域名验证 200 且无需登录，Space 卡片原文经 hf-mirror.com 镜像读取官方 raw 文件（证据 URL 仍为官方原址）。Space 卡片许可为 other，不声称开源；本站未实测。
notes.en: Official IndexTeam Space demonstrating IndexTTS-2.5 zero-shot TTS. Release date taken from the published date of official GitHub release v2.5.0 (2026-08-13). Verification: huggingface.co is unreachable from the local network; the demo returned 200 via the official hf.space direct domain with auth_required false, and the Space card was read from the official raw file via the hf-mirror.com mirror (evidence URLs remain the official pages). Space card license is 'other'; no open-source claim. Not run by this site.
